methodology.data: Original embedded report data. No source refresh or synthetic substitution. All downloaded file SHA-256 values and loaded explicit measure definitions checked.

methodology.follow_up: Both candidates repeated with explicitly selected source-connected axes, empty actual iterator source table and matrix subtotals. Two excluded priming queries, then 15 alternating AB/BA warm pairs per context.
methodology.validation: Strict DAX == and separate ISBLANK flags. Candidate and original-formula aliases each checked against saved source measure. Nonblank evidence required before timing.
methodology.finding_rule: Faster/slower requires median change above both 10% and 1 ms and nonoverlapping sample ranges; descriptive, not a significance test.
methodology.limits: Client execution plus full result reading/conversion, not isolated measure CPU/FE/SE. Warm caches only. Finite probes, not captured report visual workloads, RLS or universal equivalence.
